milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because the crafted wooden_shovel ends up in the player's inventory after crafting at the crafting table. The player starts with 2 sticks and 1 oak plank (exact ingredients), and no wooden_shovel exists in the starting inventory, so having one confirms successful crafting.

Uses count_in_box_at_most with kind='block' and object='podzol' because podzol drops dirt (not podzol) when mined without Silk Touch, making inventory_has unusable. Instead, we verify that at least one podzol block has been removed from the 3x3 podzol patch (originally 9 blocks) by checking the count decreased to at most 8. The bounding box [-5,-3,-5] to [1,0,1] spawn-relative generously encompasses the patch placed at (-3,-1,-3) to (-1,-1,-1).
